summary: Iteration 2: customer_email + settlement refund emails (Emergent/Resend) and landing redesign all working. Backend 34/34 pytest pass (11 new email/settlement tests + 23 regression). Verified: invalid email variants -> 400 'Enter a valid email address'; valid/whitespace-trimmed email persisted; blank email -> null; settled YES ticker (KXRAIN-26OCT16-CHI) -> refunded + refund_email_status 'sent' + refund_email_id, stats.refund_emails_sent/refunded increment; 2nd dashboard load does NOT resend (refund_email_at/id unchanged); YES w/o email -> 'no_email'; settled NO (KXRAIN-26OCT23-CHI) -> expired, no email; weekend-kind label path sends; dashboard settles only its own merchant. Email proxy returned 202 Accepted in backend logs. Frontend @375px: solid blue hero (rgb 37,99,235, no images), logo tile, 'Get started' (52px tall) -> /merchants; no 'demo' text on landing or merchant picker. Checkout: invalid email shows checkout-error, valid email shows "we'll email delivered@resend.dev", New booking clears email. Dashboard settled-summary shows '1 refunded · 1 expired dry · 1 refund emails sent'. Regression replay + onboarding OK. No deprecated Expo packages detected.

minor.issue: Guarantee is flipped to 'refunded' BEFORE the email is attempted. Failures (refund_email_status 'failed:*') are never retried, and any exception outside the send_email try (e.g. date.fromisoformat on a bad date, merchant lookup) leaves the doc 'refunded' with no refund_email_status forever -> customer never notified. Consider a retry pass for status in (None, failed:*) where status=='refunded' and customer_email set, claimed atomically via a 'sending' marker.

Settlement (one Kalshi call per distinct active ticker + serial email sends, 30s timeout each) runs inline in the request; dashboard latency scales with number of settled tickers/emails. Consider firing settlement as a background task and returning immediately.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Email for refund alerts' input is shown and accepted even when rain refund toggle is OFF; on confirm the email is silently discarded (no guarantee created). Hide/disable the field when toggle is off or show a hint.

action_items: Add retry/recovery for refund emails that failed or were never attempted after the guarantee was flipped to refunded
Move settlement off the dashboard request path (background task) to keep dashboard fast
Hide or disable checkout-email-input when rain refund toggle is off
